LuciferBundle25_Joy/Joy_Barks_LuciferBar.en: Huh. I cannot figure out your smile, Lucifer. It says "happy" but definitely something else, too.

LuciferBundle25_Joy/Joy_Barks_LuciferBar.en: Aw, I always wanted Riley to get a cat. And you're just extra fluffy, aren't ya?!

LuciferBundle25_Joy/Joy_Barks_LuciferBar.en: I think somebody needs some chin scratches and positive reinforcement!
